title: Fix data-protection keys path to use AppContext.BaseDirectory
description: P1 — Data-protection keys path in MemorySmithSecuritySetup.cs defaults to `Path.Combine("..", "Data", "Keys")` relative to `Directory.GetCurrentDirectory()` instead of `AppContext.BaseDirectory`. In published/deployed scenarios where CWD differs from the app location, this causes key loss — all users logged out, all encrypted data unreadable. Fix: use `Path.Combine(AppContext.BaseDirectory, "..", "Data", "Keys")` or make the default an absolute path. Found in 10-agent codebase audit 2026-07-10 (P1-001).

comments.author: anonymous
